checks.case: admin exports orders for 2026-11-01..2026-11-21 as xlsx
checks.expected: workbook with the same rows the orders list shows for that range
checks.observed: HTTP 200, content-type application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 540750 bytes, sheet1.xml contains 504 <row> elements (1 header + 503 data rows)
checks.note: the orders list reports total = 506 for the same range — three orders created between 00:00 and 02:00 Cairo time on 2026-11-01 are missing from the export

checks.expected: 403 — the export exposes customer names, phone numbers and addresses

checks.case: employee role exports orders as csv
checks.observed: HTTP 200, text/csv, 18545 bytes, UTF-8 BOM + Arabic header row (رقم الطلب, تاريخ الطلب, اسم العميل, ...)

checks.expected: an ASCII fallback that still identifies the file
checks.observed: content-disposition: attachment; filename="orders_20________2026.xlsx"; filename*=UTF-8''orders_20_%D9%86%D9%88%D9%81%D9%85%D8%A8%D8%B1_2026.xlsx — the RFC 5987 form is correct, the ASCII fallback drops the Arabic month name entirely
checks.note: cosmetic: clients that only read the plain filename receive orders_20________2026.xlsx

side_effects: none — the export route reads through the RLS-respecting client and writes no rows
